description: Liste des implantations liées aux infrastructures inscrites dans la feuille de route française des infrastructures de recherche 2018 is a dataset listed in Occitanie open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Région Occitanie. Ce jeu de données fournit la liste des implantations liées aux infrastructures en région Occitanie inscrites dans la feuille de route française des infrastructures de recherche 2018. Vous pouvez également consulter le moteur de recherche ou la cartographie des infrastructures de recherche de la feuille de route 2018. Coverage: Occitanie. The portal files it under Attractivité et Innovation. Its keywords are infrastructure, recherche universitaire, enseignement. The portal shows 57 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-08-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-laregion-fr-portal.
